OpenAI-Compatible Images 1.0.2 adds English and Chinese Plugin UI text, preserves focused-canvas drafts across task changes, and publishes matched English and Simplified Chinese user documentation.

## Highlights

- Uses English as the public Plugin metadata default.
- Treats `zh`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, and other Chinese locale variants as one Chinese Widget locale; missing or non-Chinese locales use English.
- Restores the latest draft for each image after task switching, returning to the conversation, or reopening the canvas.
- Opens and resumes the focused canvas without the startup delay addressed in this patch.
- Uses English for both runtime Skill contracts and provides matched English and Simplified Chinese public guides.
- Verifies first-time Standalone installation from the versioned archive with the third-party `skills@latest` CLI for Codex.

## Install

Install the Codex Plugin from the Git-backed marketplace, or download the matching Plugin or Standalone archive together with `SHA256SUMS` from this Release. Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/Syh1906/openai-compatible-imagegen/blob/v1.0.2/docs/guides/installation.md) for marketplace, versioned ZIP, and first-time Skills CLI installation.

## Known limitations

- The repository root is not a valid `skills` CLI package because it contains Plugin, MCP, Widget, test, and documentation files. Install from the extracted Standalone Skill archive instead.
- The third-party `skills@latest` CLI supports first-time project and user installation from the extracted Standalone archive. Local copied installs are not updated by `skills update`, and repeated `add` removes the installed `auth.json`. Project-level `remove` can leave the install registered; the verified user-level `remove --global` completed cleanly. Use versioned ZIP directories for updates and rollback.
